title: A customer created without AP/AR access gets the default Net 30
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user on a custom role that has Customers → Create & Edit but not View and Manage AP/AR Data.
  • Make sure Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Choose a name for the new customer, customer A.
  • Have an Admin signed in to a second browser, to check the result.
  • Start on the Customers page.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Type the name of customer A in Customer Name.
  3. Click Save.
  4. In the Admin's browser, open Edit Customer for customer A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Customer" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The field shows the name as typed.

Step 3:

  • The window closes and the new customer is saved.

Step 4:

  • Credit Terms reads Net 30 and the customer has no credit limit (blank).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-N4: “If the user does not have the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' setting, the server ignores any term or limit sent with their save: a customer they create gets the shop's default term, with a $0 limit when the default is COD and no limit otherwise; a customer they edit keeps its stored term and limit.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “A user without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' who creates or edits a customer has any term or limit they send ignored by the server (S5-N4).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
